module: Flowgraph node "File Vehicle Group" (once_p_duration). Loads a .vehGroup.json file (jsonReadFile). If the file has a generator or no data, the group is generated with core_multiSpawn.createGroup(amount, generator) (amount defaults to 10). Output: group (vehicleGroupData) for the traffic spawn nodes.

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution stops; releases the internal state.

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

onNodeReset.desc: Called when the node is reset; resets its internal state.

postInit.desc: Called after the node's pins are created; used to adjust the pins (value templates, file filters, dynamic keys).

work.desc: On the first call, resolves the path, reads the file, generates the data if needed and publishes the group; node error if the file is not found.
